verdict: Organic channels holding; search visibility softening across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all measurable activity this period came entirely from organic Google Business Profile and Search Console — no paid spend ran on any channel for any entity. Combined, your three profiles delivered 360 total GBP actions over the last 28 days, led by direction requests, web clicks, and calls. However, Search Console clicks fell meaningfully in the final 7 days across all three locations — down 43%, 46%, and 34% respectively versus the prior 7 — and GBP actions followed a similar downward pattern heading into October; the organic visibility root cause is actively being investigated and a fix is being submitted. The profile friction on the Precision Ground Bars and Precision Ground Metals listings, which drew strong direction interest but generated zero calls this period, is also being addressed through profile and call-to-action review.

organic search clicks across all three locations this period

watch_item.issue: Search Console clicks dropped sharply in the final 7 days across all three locations, paralleled by a pullback in GBP actions — pointing to softening organic visibility.
watch_item.fix: The SEO root cause is being identified and a fix is being submitted this period, with site reindexing targeted for completion by end of October.
